The other man, with long curly hair and a brown cap, gestures towards a woman in the distance. The background is filled with gym equipment, including cable machines and weight racks. (2) The muscular man with pink hair turns and walks away from the camera down a narrow hallway towards a woman standing further back. The man in the cap remains in the foreground, watching him leave. The lighting is uniform and artificial throughout the space. (3) The camera focuses on the man in the cap in a close-up shot. He speaks with a somber and reflective facial expression, looking slightly downward and then back at the camera. The background shows blurred gym machinery and the other couple in the distance. (4) A smartphone is brought close to the lens, showing a digital photo of the two men together. One is wearing a Santa costume, and they are both smiling. The screen reflects some of the overhead gym lights.
